look_here_first: Inspect the yellow head from below: long green outer phyllaries, a domed disk and notched ray tips. Then inspect alternate leaves with clasping upper leaf bases. A mature cypsela has papery pappus scales.

key_traits.label: Leaves
key_traits.text: Alternate; lower spatulate, upper ovate and sessile to clasping.

key_traits.label: Heads
key_traits.text: Solitary yellow capitula, long outer phyllaries and domed disk.

key_traits.label: Fruit
key_traits.text: Cypsela with short papery pappus scales.

lookalikes.differences: Compare outer and inner phyllaries, upper leaf attachment, and mature pappus scales rather than flower color.
